fullText: Hello, Mother, Dad, and David and everyone else at home. Well, right now I'm in Da Nang Harbor and right beside me is Bill. He came aboard the ship just about an hour and a half ago. I was pretty surprised to see him. He said it was about 12 o'clock. It's about quarter to 3 right here. This is Tuesday, April 16th. He's been telling me some of his little war stories and some of the games that they've been playing over here. And they seem to be in pretty good spirits and pretty good shape. I'm having a mic over to him right now and I didn't say a few words. Well, it took a pretty long time getting off this ship. I got in the, or left, uh, left at Hoi An at the, uh, chopper's ship about, uh, 9 o'clock. And got in here about, uh, quarter to 9, I think it was. And, uh, you know, we got pretty high there. I was pretty surprised, I was surprised the choppers fly. I thought they could go up. I got in here around 20 after 9 I think it was. I ran out of the third mast. I didn't really know where to go. I asked the guy who was driving the Navy truck to where the deep water pool was. He said, I'll take you halfway down there. I said, okay. I went down there. I got another ride on down to here.
